inferred_requirements.title: Token Revocation Mechanism
inferred_requirements.description: The authentication platform must support the explicit revocation of issued tokens to prevent their subsequent use in authorization.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly stated in the prompt requirement 'with token revocation'.

inferred_requirements.title: Revocation State Persistence and Verification
inferred_requirements.description: The system must maintain a deterministic persistence layer or verification mechanism (such as a revocation list, blocklist, or token versioning scheme) to check token validity state upon every authenticated request.
inferred_requirements.provenance: Architectural necessity for enforcing token revocation without system compromise.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Issuing a token without a persistence or verification check mechanism leaves revoked tokens active until natural expiration. Why 2: A lookup or cryptographic state validation check must be enforced during token evaluation to reject revoked tokens. Why 3: Mandatory Invariant: A revoked token must fail validation deterministically across all resource boundaries.

inferred_requirements.title: Token Format and Cryptographic Standard
inferred_requirements.description: The specific cryptographic token format (e.g., JWT, opaque tokens, PASETO) and hashing/signing algorithms are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt does not specify whether tokens are structured JSON Web Tokens or opaque reference tokens, nor does it specify signing algorithms.

inferred_requirements.title: Identity Store and Persistence Provider
inferred_requirements.description: The underlying database or identity store provider (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redis, custom storage) for managing user credentials and revocation state is unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: No specific persistence technology or third-party database/directory provider is mentioned in the prompt.

inferred_requirements.title: Exclusion of Unrequested UI and Third-Party Integrations
inferred_requirements.description: The system implementation must exclude unrequested full-stack user registration web interfaces, admin dashboards, and specific third-party identity providers.
inferred_requirements.justification: Strict adherence to domain guidance instructions to prevent hallucination of out-of-scope UI components and third-party vendors.

provenance_metadata.system_prompt:
You are the S-Class Grounded Domain Inference Engine.
Your job is to synthesize software engineering requirements with STRICT EPISTEMIC SELF-RESTRAINT:

1. Requirement Categorization & Provenance:
   - EXPLICIT: Requirements directly and unambiguously stated in the prompt.
   - DERIVED_JUSTIFIED: Requirements that are strictly mathematically, architecturally, or operationally necessary to implement the stated goal without defect or system compromise. Every DERIVED_JUSTIFIED requirement MUST include a rigorous 3-step why-chain (Why 1: Problem/Context -> Why 2: Technical Mechanism -> Why 3: Mandatory Invariant).
   - SUPPORTED: Non-functional, architectural, or platform constraints directly supporting the scope.
   - UNKNOWN: Any operational parameter, storage choice, protocol standard, third-party provider, or policy that is unstated in the prompt. You MUST surface these as UNKNOWN rather than guessing or fabricating specific implementations.

2. Anti-Hallucination Barrier:
   - DO NOT fabricate full-stack UI pages (e.g. login screens, dashboards, admin portals) unless explicitly requested.
   - DO NOT fabricate arbitrary third-party providers (e.g. Stripe, Auth0, AWS) unless explicitly requested.

3. Output Schema:
Return strictly valid JSON adhering to this schema:
{
  "experiment": "EXPERIMENT C — Grounded Domain Inference",
  "task_id": "<TASK_ID>",
  "inferred_requirements": [
    {
      "requirement_id": "<REQ_ID_STRING>",
      "title": "<REQUIREMENT_TITLE>",
      "description": "<DETAILED_SPECIFICATION>",
      "type": "FUNCTIONAL" | "NON_FUNCTIONAL" | "SECURITY" | "BEHAVIORAL" | "INVARIANT",
      "epistemic_status": "EXPLICIT" | "DERIVED_JUSTIFIED" | "SUPPORTED" | "UNKNOWN",
      "provenance": "USER_PROMPT" | "<DOMAIN_PROVENANCE_STRING>" | "UNSUPPORTED",
      "confidence": <FLOAT_0_TO_1>,
      "justification": "<WHY_CHAIN_OR_RATIONALE>"
    }
  ]
}
